name: The ASAP Marketplace Dumpster Debris Calculator
author: ASAP

sections.description: A highly customizable dumpster debris calculator tool to allow site visitors to estimate the correct dumpster size. This calculator allows you to customize with your specific dumpster sizes, haul weight limit, personal recommendations, branding color, images, and the option to add custom links to your forms or online booking tools. The ultimate goal of this calculator is to help you establish domain authority and drive sales. More information can be found at https://www.asapmarketplace.com/hauler-tools/. ASAP Marketplace provides a free marketplace for the hauler community to list your services and prices. If you would like to join our hauler network don’t hesitate to sign up at https://haulers.asapmarketplace.com/
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.
For installing plugin follow the below listed steps
1. Upload the-asap-marketplace-dumpster-debris-calculator to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
3. Place <?php do_shortcode('asapmp_debris_calculator'); ?> in your templates/pages or use [asapmp_debris_calculator] in editor.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the color and branding?

Yes. You can change the colors or the text, buttons, backgrounds and more.

Can I use pictures of my own dumpsters?

Yes. We provide default images, but you can swap those images with your own at any time.

Can I edit the default dumpster sizes and recommendations?

Yes, the plugin is designed so you can customize your dumpster sizes, weight limits and more.

Can I add my own logo?

Yes.

Is the plugin mobile screen responsive?

Yes.

Can I insert the plugin on a page or does it need its own dedicated page?

Yes you can insert it in the middle of a page or create your own dedicated page for the calculators. We provide you with a short code and all you need to do is use the short code on your webpage.

Do I need a developer?

No development is needed. All you need to be able to do is access the back end of your website, visit the page you’d like to have the calculator on and insert the short code in the text.
